turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, welcome to support, how can I help?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I am on the starter plan and thinking about upgrading. What does the pro plan cost and what is included?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: The pro plan is twenty euros a month. It adds unlimited projects, priority support, and the reporting module.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Is there a discount if I pay yearly?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Yes, the yearly price is two hundred euros, so two months free compared to monthly billing.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That sounds great, I will discuss it with my team and upgrade from the settings page.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Perfect, the upgrade takes effect immediately when you do. Anything else?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, that was everything. Very helpful, thank you!
